strategy.exit_rule: hold to expiry unless stop hit; force-close by Friday ~3pm ET bar regardless

notes: *** EXTREME-VOLATILITY CALIBRATION CAVEAT (READ FIRST) *** This dataset covers the COVID-19 crash and recovery period (2019-12-02 through 2020-12-28). During Feb-Nov 2020, VIX repeatedly spiked far outside the ~15-35 range that the strike-selection formula (Black-Scholes delta approximation, short_put_delta_target 0.16, short_call_delta_target 0.21, wing_width 6, calibrated on 2025/2026 data) was designed for. Multiple weeks used a VIX input in the 35-66 range (peaking at 66.04 the week of 2020-03-23), and intraday VIX spiked into the 80s. In these EXTREME VOL weeks, the resulting strikes may sit further from the true target deltas than the formula normally achieves, and should be treated as 'close enough for backtest purposes' rather than what a live trader would actually have selected in the moment. Every such week is flagged individually below. *** COVID CIRCUIT-BREAKER WEEK CAVEAT *** The week of 2020-03-16 saw multiple market-wide circuit-breaker trading halts. Hourly option bars for that week may be sparse, gapped, or dominated by interpolated (gap-filled, flat) bars rather than real observed trades. This is expected market behavior for that week, not a data error. Real historical Robinhood option prices for 57 SPY weekly $6/$6 iron condors, Dec 2019 - Dec 2020 (entry dates 2019-12-02 through 2020-12-28, expiries through 2020-12-31). Strikes were pre-selected using a Black-Scholes delta approximation against each week's SPY open and prior-week VIX close per pull_condor_history.py; strikes and settle prices are therefore estimates of where those deltas fell, not exact broker-reported greeks at entry. 'hourly_closes' arrays are hourly last-trade closes from the entry day's first bar through expiry-day's last bar; the vast majority of bars for these old, illiquid, expired contracts are Robinhood-reported as interpolated (gap-filled, flat-priced) rather than real observed trades -- only the final bar of most weeks (and occasionally a few others) reflects a real trade. 'entry_prices' are the (short_put, long_put, short_call, long_call) prices at the first hourly bar (~10am ET, DST-adjusted) on the entry date. 'settle' is SPY's official close on expiry day. All option instrument IDs and hourly historicals were pulled live from Robinhood for expired SPY weekly options; no MISSING legs were encountered (all 57 weeks x 4 legs = 228 legs resolved and priced on the first attempt).
